final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_orders FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - o.avg_orders AS above_all_avg FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE oc.order_count > o.avg_orders), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_orders FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.above_all_avg, k.order_count - ka.avg_orders AS above_kept_avg FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_avg AS ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
